status.label: Design candidate
status.detail: Keyboard Manager modifier remap leaves Ctrl logically stuck after a specific Ctrl+Alt chord.

next_action.label: Design fix
next_action.reason: The repro gives exact remaps, key chord, host app symptom, and recovery key.

actions.label: Design fix
actions.note: Dashboard-only action. No upstream comment or PR is posted by this artifact update.

judgment.rationale: The Keyboard Manager report has a concrete modifier-remap scenario and observable stuck-Ctrl symptom suitable for targeted design investigation.
evidence: Issue body: Left Ctrl is remapped to Left Win and Left Win to Left Ctrl.
Repro: in Chrome, pressing Left Ctrl + Alt + 4 causes later mouse scrolling to zoom as if Ctrl is held.
Reporter says pressing Left Ctrl once releases the stuck state.
judgment.recommended_action: Run a full Keyboard Manager design investigation focused on modifier key-up/state handling for swapped Ctrl/Win remaps and Ctrl+Alt chords.
